scope: conditional candidate comparison; no satellite identity claim

protocol.outer_split: seeded random whole visits, shared by both receivers
protocol.training_response: even-symbol adjacent-frame phase advances on training visits
protocol.held_response: odd-symbol adjacent-frame phase advances on held visits
protocol.frame_policy: four IQ-blind adjacent frames nearest each 20 ms group center
protocol.candidate_bank: top five causal-TLE candidates from exact phase-blind track review
protocol.candidate_tau: frozen phase-blind TLE-review tau per candidate
protocol.nuisance: one candidate/track/receiver frequency bias fitted on even training only
protocol.baseline_orientation: 8 cm horizontal RX0-to-RX1 azimuth and one receiver CFO offset fitted per candidate/scan on random training visits; held visits only evaluate

joint_receivers.combination: equal receiver mean after separate train-only frequency biases
